Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Replaces global one-use held-key consumption with a shared per-frame scheduler: Purify, Recuperate, ally cleanse, counter-CC, and every other held helper may react in priority order from one continuous hold. Exact intents wait through known cooldown, resource, cast, queue, and animation-lock blocks; only explicit client rejection permits a bounded same-intent retry, while acceptance or ambiguity is terminal. NIN Seiton now joins held scheduling, Combat Frames expose disabled interaction clearly, and LB activation no longer covers HP/MP bars.
